content:
alex-k: hi all, first-day snag. Okta stops me with 'Passkey required by policy' when trying to SSO on my Pixel 6. i don't have a YubiKey yet and chrome on android isn't offering a passkey option. who do i ping?

devex_lee: welcome alex! :wave: we just rolled a stricter MFA policy for some teams. two short paths: 1) create a platform passkey via Chrome on Android (if your phone supports it) or 2) we can temporarily allow SMS OTP for 24h while a YubiKey ships. do you have 1password access from your onboarding email?

alex-k: i got the 1password invite but haven't finished because Okta blocks me before i can complete the flows. i'm currently on wifi at home.

it_support_bot: Ticket created: #IT-4620 — "Okta passkey enforced, new hire alex-k blocked". Assigned to devex_lee. Status: open.

devex_lee: ok. quick test: open Chrome on your Pixel -> Settings -> Passwords -> Passkeys. If you see "Create passkey" you can use that and then register it in Okta when prompted. If not, we can fallback. also try Chrome Canary if standard Chrome is missing the feature.

alex-k: checked — no passkeys section under Passwords. Chrome version 112. i can try Canary but not sure i want to install unstable channel on my phone right away.

peopleops_rita: i can expedite a YubiKey overnight if needed. which office should we ship it to? or do you want it sent to your home? also we can approve the SMS temporary allowance so you can finish onboarding immediately.

alex-k: please ship to my home address on file. and yes, temporary SMS would be great so i can finish 1password and google and set up passkeys later. thanks!

1password_admin: we can also generate one-time backup codes in 1Password that you can use to sign in to Okta if SMS flaps. once devex_lee grants the bypass, i'll add a shared vault entry named "alex-k / onboarding backup codes" with instructions.

devex_lee: granting temporary Okta policy exception: SMS OTP allowed for alex-k for 24 hours. You should now see an SMS option at login.

it_support_bot: Update: #IT-4620 changed status to in_progress (devex_lee).

alex-k: saw SMS prompt, got code, in. i finished the 1Password invite flow and can access shared docs now. do i still need the YubiKey?

peopleops_rita: yes we prefer hardware keys for SRE/dev infra teams. shipping YubiKey NOW via overnight. tracking: 1Z999AA10123456784 (I'll DM tracking).

1password_admin: created vault item with two one-time backup codes and a short how-to. also added a note reminding you to register the hardware key in Okta under Security Methods after it arrives.

devex_lee: when the key arrives, quick steps for Okta: 1) Console -> Settings -> Security Methods -> Add factor -> Security key. 2) follow browser prompt, tap YubiKey. If you want to set a device passkey on Android later, we can help migrate.

alex-k: thanks all — SMS got me in and i'm in the #team channel. appreciate the fast help and the YubiKey shipping. will post again if anything else pops. :smile:

it_support_bot: #IT-4620 resolved. Reopen if access issues recur."
